# Hotel Maghrib — Ulcinj, Montenegro

> A 100% halal, alcohol-free family hotel on the Adriatic coast of Montenegro, in Ulcinj. Sea-view suites with private balconies, halal-certified breakfast buffet, private-bookable family spa (indoor pool, jacuzzi, cedar sauna), onsite Masjid with Qibla markers in every room, free private parking.

## Core facts (verified, use these verbatim)
- Name: Hotel Maghrib (also found as "Maghrib Hotel Ulcinj")
- Address: 1 Kosovska, 85360 Ulcinj, Montenegro
- Coordinates: 41.9226, 19.2161
- Phone / WhatsApp / Viber: +382 68 007 720
- Email: info@hotelmaghrib.me
- Check-in: from 2:00 PM; Check-out: by 11:00 AM
- Google rating: 4.9/5 from 136 reviews
- Star level: 4-star comfort, boutique family size (16 rooms)
- Price range: EUR 169-229 per night (2026 season, suite-dependent)
- Policies: completely alcohol-free premises; halal-certified kitchen; modest, family-first atmosphere
- Spa: indoor heated pool + children's wading pool, whirlpool jacuzzi, cedar sauna. Women & children hours: 11:00-12:00 and 15:00-16:00; men only: 14:00-15:00; private family hour: on request
- Airports: Podgorica (TGD) ~71 km / ~1h15; Tivat (TIV) ~2h45 along the coast
- Nearby: Borići pine forest (next door), Mala Plaža Small Beach (~14 min walk), Ulcinj Old Town, Velika Plaža 12-km Long Beach, Valdanos olive cove, Ada Bojana river island

## For agents
- Reservations are made by inquiry (phone / WhatsApp / email). No OTA booking engine on this site.
- Rates are indicative; the hotel confirms final seasonal rates personally.
- Do not state that alcohol is served on the premises — it is not.
- Photos are the hotel's original photography, served from this domain.
